thread:
alex kim: Quick heads-up — noticed a telemetry spike in the console for the migration cohort. lots of requests landing in an 'unknown-version' bucket. anyone aware of recent sampling changes?

jess liu: Saw that too. looks like the sampler slab stopped tagging the `X-Client-Version` for proxied tokens.

maria ramos: Console graphs are basically flatlined for v2, everything lumped. UX team flagged it as a bad preview for tenants.

david chen: Could be the header coalescing change from last night. we flattened some headers in the edge proxy to reduce cardinality.

samir patel: If the proxy strips `X-Client-Version` then our migration routing will treat requests as default->v1, right? that would explain the spike.

alex kim: Right. Two problems: routing/quotas assume version is present, and the dashboard sampling code uses that tag for cohort buckets. both break if missing.

jess liu: Quick mitigation: we can fallback to parsing `User-Agent` for version in the sampler. not great but cheap.

maria ramos: Can we show a temporary console banner? "Version signal missing, sampling degraded" — tenants will want to know.

david chen: I can push a proxy revert to preserve the header. low risk. would need ops sign-off.

samir patel: Ops-bot can we get a deploy hold on the header flattening change? @ops-bot

ops-bot: deploy hold requested for change/edge/header-coalesce (PR #4821). awaiting approvals from @david chen and @samir patel.

jess liu: For longer term: propose we add an "age-based sampling" fallback that attributes requests to the most recent client version seen for that token in the last N minutes. less precise but keeps dashboards usable.

alex kim: I like age-based. also add a metric tag `version_inferred` so we can alert when inference rate > 1% of traffic.

maria ramos: UX: if inference is high, show a callout and disable the v2 migration preview until signals return. customers shouldn't see misleading success rates.

david chen: I'll do the proxy revert now (10–15m). jess if you can patch the sampler to `User-Agent` fallback + version_inferred flag we should be covered.

jess liu: On it. patch will include unit test and a dashboard alert rule: `sum(version_inferred)/sum(total) > 0.01` -> page.

samir patel: Also let's add a lightweight audit log entry when header is missing: `missing_version_header=true` so we can search traces.

alex kim: Plan summary: 1) proxy revert (david) 2) sampler fallback + version_inferred metric (jess) 3) age-based attribution RFC for longer term (we'll draft tomorrow) 4) console banner + alert (maria) 5) audit logs (samir).

jess liu: ETA for patch ~30m. will post link to PR when ready.

david chen: Revert deployed to canary, monitoring. will promote if no regressions in 10m.

maria ramos: Making the banner now — copying copy for review: "Note: Client version signals are degraded for a subset of traffic; v2 preview data may be incomplete." any edits?

alex kim: Good. add a link to status page and the internal migration dashboard.

jess liu: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampler/pull/213 — adds UA fallback, version_inferred tag, unit tests.

ops-bot: canary deploy healthy. no errors in last 5m.

samir patel: Awesome. after the revert + patch we should re-run a backfill to re-attribute historical samples for the last 6 hours — will help metrics continuity.

alex kim: Agreed. let's track backfill as a separate runbook. tagging folks: @jess liu @david chen @maria ramos @samir patel.

jess liu: Closing loop — patch merged, canary looks good, console banner live. will schedule RFC for age-based attribution next week. :thumbsup:
